title: Treaty of Adrianople
legal_context: Russo-Ottoman peace settlement confirming the position and privileges of Moldavia and Wallachia after the 1828-1829 war.
territorial_scope: Danubian Principalities and Danube arrangements; not a surveyed modern Romanian national boundary.
citation: Edward Hertslet, The Map of Europe by Treaty, vol. I (1875), no. 145
locator: No. 145, Arts. V-VI and separate act, pp. 813-823
repository: Internet Archive research scan of the Foreign Office compilation
notes: Text and legal scope only. Any linework must come from a separately identified contemporary delimitation source.

title: General Treaty of Paris
legal_context: Crimean War peace settlement placing the Danubian Principalities under collective guarantee and requiring a Bessarabian frontier rectification.
territorial_scope: Southern Bessarabia, Moldavia, Wallachia, and the Danube settlement.
citation: Edward Hertslet, The Map of Europe by Treaty, vol. II (1875), no. 264
repository: Internet Archive research scan of the Foreign Office compilation
alternatives: Treaty wording; the subsequently surveyed boundary commission line; later cartographic reconstructions
notes: The treaty directs delegates to trace the new line. Its prose is not a substitute for the commission record or map.

title: Treaty of Berlin
legal_context: European settlement recognizing Romanian independence and revising the Bessarabian and Dobruja territorial settlement.
territorial_scope: Romania's restitution of southern Bessarabia to Russia and acquisition of Dobruja, the Danube Delta, and Serpent Island.
citation: Edward Hertslet, The Map of Europe by Treaty, vol. IV (1891), no. 530
locator: No. 530, Arts. XLIII-XLVI, pp. 2787-2789; treaty map facing p. 2788
repository: Internet Archive research scan of the Foreign Office compilation
alternatives: Treaty description and inset map; 1878-1879 European boundary commission acts; later national reconstructions
notes: The compilation includes treaty-era maps, but neither map nor prose has been reconciled with the implementation commission.

title: Treaty of Bucharest
legal_context: Second Balkan War settlement among Bulgaria, Greece, Montenegro, Romania, and Serbia.
territorial_scope: Romanian-Bulgarian frontier in Southern Dobruja and the wider Balkan territorial settlement.
citation: British and Foreign State Papers, vol. 107, pp. 658-663
locator: Art. II, pp. 659-660; signed 28 July/10 August 1913
repository: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian, citation pointer to the official series
alternatives: Old Style and New Style dates; treaty description; subsequent delimitation protocols and maps
notes: The stable repository page verifies the official-series locator but does not reproduce the treaty. Acquire and collate the cited volume before transcription.

title: Treaty of Trianon
legal_context: Post-First World War peace treaty with Hungary defining its frontiers with successor and neighbouring states.
territorial_scope: Hungarian-Romanian frontier, described as a sequence of points and lines subject to on-the-ground delimitation.
citation: League of Nations Treaty Series, vol. 6, pp. 187-457
locator: Part II, Art. 27(3), pp. 225-229; maps and frontier commission provisions elsewhere in the volume
repository: United Nations Treaty Collection, League of Nations Treaty Series
alternatives: Treaty line; boundary commission demarcation; later cadastral and national GIS representations
notes: The treaty volume is the legal source. Modern boundary datasets may help locate places but cannot become the authority for the 1920 line.

title: Second Vienna Award
legal_context: German-Italian arbitration imposed after failed Romanian-Hungarian negotiations.
territorial_scope: Transfer of northern Transylvania from Romania to Hungary, with execution questions left to direct negotiation.
citation: Foreign Relations of the United States, Diplomatic Papers, 1940, General, vol. I
repository: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
alternatives: Translated award text; attached map referenced by paragraph 1; implementation records; later reconstructions
notes: This is an official U.S. documentary-series translation. The map referenced in the award is not present on the document page and must be acquired separately.

title: Armistice Agreement with Romania
legal_context: Allied armistice after Romania left the Axis, pending definitive disposition at the peace settlement.
territorial_scope: Provisional treatment of Transylvania and recognition of the 1940 Soviet-Romanian frontier.
citation: Foreign Relations of the United States, Diplomatic Papers, 1944, Europe, vol. IV
repository: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
alternatives: Contemporaneous drafts vary between all or the greater part of Transylvania; the final armistice remained subject to the peace settlement
notes: An armistice is deliberately typed apart from a final treaty. It supplies legal context, not an authoritative final frontier geometry.

title: Treaty of Peace with Romania
legal_context: Post-Second World War peace settlement restoring the Romanian-Hungarian frontier and confirming other Romanian frontiers by reference.
territorial_scope: Romanian frontiers as of 1 January 1941, except restoration of the Romanian-Hungarian frontier of 1 January 1938.
citation: United Nations Treaty Series, vol. 42, no. 645, pp. 3-77
locator: Part I, Arts. 1-2, pp. 34-36; Annex I map between pp. 124-125
alternatives: Treaty references to earlier legal frontiers; Annex I map; national implementations and later reconstructions
notes: The annex map must be extracted and assessed in its own typed record before any digitisation. The treaty's historical reference dates remain part of the legal definition.
